routes.detail: Lazy JourneysPage inside SafeRoute; import at line 66. Registration is source evidence, not exercised route reachability.

purpose: Journey Autopilot session management: plan a named vehicle trip, manage its lifecycle and versioned plans, score stops, assess departure/readiness, follow a live session, replan, prepare arrival and inspect its debrief.
primaryGoal: Select the workspace vehicle, create or open its journey session and use source-backed planning/live/debrief actions without conflating sessions with recorded drives or inferred observed journeys.

dataSources.ownership: Shared workspace selection: path/query vehicle_id, persisted selection, then fleet fallback. JourneysPage consumes vehicleId at line 18 and renders no competing picker.
dataSources.limits: Fleet errors/loading are not exposed in SelectedVehicleResult; no mounted fleet or header behavior verified.

dataSources.ownership: Session and plan payloads owned by journey API; next_statuses drives allowed buttons, not a replacement frontend state machine. JourneyPanel owns filter, selected session and draft.
dataSources.contracts: journeyKeys includes vehicle/status for lists and session ID for detail. Reads forward AbortSignal, normalize nullable arrays and reuse queryPolicy('operational'); mutations invalidateAndBroadcast and toast.
dataSources.limits: No backend handler/query implementation or API response exercised. No date-range list behavior inferred.

dataSources.ownership: Fleet-known charging candidate sites are a distinct historical source, not journey session records. Scores persist a plan through the mutation contract. Departure uses independent future business windows; checklist latest 404 means never run in caller logic.
dataSources.contracts: Candidate cap 10, first 20 sites shown; coordinate prerequisites. energy_wh, wait_s and corridor_m remain canonical payload fields. Departure forecast window uses 12/24/48 hours, not workspace analysis range.
dataSources.limits: Forecast/scoring/readiness algorithms, persistence and 404 meaning are frontend contracts/comments only, not backend/runtime proof.

dataSources.ownership: Journey session live checkpoints/progress/range and journey report remain distinct from route-history factor/trip support and checklist denominators.
dataSources.contracts: Live/arrival use live query policy; assessments/report use operational. Reads forward cancellation. Check-in invalidates live/replan/arrival/report; replan invalidates detail/live/replan/report. Outbox stores session_id plus original recorded_at and replays sequentially on online status.
dataSources.limits: Backend 15-second ambient tick, timestamp acceptance/idempotency and real offline replay are NOT verified. No mutations performed.

components.name: PageLayout / LayoutCard / SourceContent
components.contract: Existing page adapter forwards PageContainer props and allocated-width container; persistent section shells, ready/loading/error/empty/retained source bodies with caller recovery. No new wrapper/layout engine.

components.name: JourneyPanel and lifecycle subpanels
components.contract: Feature orchestration owner. Stop scoring always within a selected detail; planned nudge, active/paused live/replan/arrival, completed/aborted report; departure/checklist for any selected detail.

components.name: DataTable / StopScoreTable
components.contract: Retain journey-sessions, journey-stop-scores and journey-replan-scores table IDs, session/site row keys, all source columns, value filters on score tables and existing shared table/export behavior. Mobile details can render all columns when the opt-in presentation is supplied.

components.name: Badge / Button / Input / Select / Checkbox / Text / MetricValue / FormSection / UnitInput
components.contract: Localized names, semantic status labels, shared focus/field handling and canonical numeric input. Do not create raw controls or independent status registry.

components.name: MetricBar / KVList / TripOperationalBrief / JourneyEvidenceList
components.owner: Existing data-display owners plus trips feature components
components.contract: Report uses shared useOperationalMetrics/OperationalBrief, numeric raw metrics and provenance/freshness. Evidence list retains actual server strings, wraps long content, and intentionally renders nothing for absent evidence.

components.name: useDataState / useUnits / useFormatting / dateFormat / useNumberFormatting / FadeIn
components.contract: Retain source trust/cancellation and display-only formatting with user settings; shared motion remains the owner. Full formatter/motion internals not inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Seven advice/live/report panels repeat DataState-to-SourceContent branching; JourneyPanel maps state differently. Shared source component already exists; duplication is adapter logic, not missing card primitive.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current SourceContent and trust adapter contracts; coordinate any common state mapping only after independent-consumer evidence, preserving checklist 404 and live no-fix exceptions.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Initial scoring and replans already share identical score presentation.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Preserve StopScoreTable rather than creating separate ranking tables.

sourceBehavior: JourneyPanel.tsx:205 stacks then xl two columns; 396-402 departure/checklist span full row and lg two columns.
JourneyPanel.tsx:210,325 uses wrapped action rows; 158,363 wraps journey/plan text. StopScorePanel.tsx:110 bounds candidate scrolling and 125 reflows form at sm.
DeparturePanel.tsx:68,117 wraps controls/slots; ArrivalPanel.tsx:71,75 wraps destination and ETA.

issues.detail: mobileColumns omits open and plan, while Open is the only explicit session selection control. Caller supplies no mobilePresentation. Shared table documents hidden nonlisted cells below md. This is a source-confirmed preservation risk, not exercised mobile loss.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable mobile presentation/row-open or details contract to keep session selection and plan version reachable at every width; do not remove hidden metadata. Check score-table price/health/corridor full details too.

requiredChecks: Open/plan/version and all ranking columns reachable
200% text, RTL, form open and source-state geometry

sourceStrengths: JourneyPanel.tsx:213 status selector has localized aria-label; inputs have labels and required name; decorative icons aria-hidden.
DeparturePanel.tsx:68-76 group label and aria-pressed horizon choices.
StopScorePanel.tsx:111-119 labeled checkbox group; LiveTripPanel.tsx:130 and StopScoreTable.tsx:58 label metric bars.
SourceContent.tsx:43,66 uses loading/status announcements; statuses have readable Badge text rather than color alone.

issues.detail: Forecast severity is exposed as raw title={slot.level}, while badge text is only time. Localized none/watch/warning text is not visibly or accessibly bound to each slot; tooltip title alone is weak touch/keyboard severity communication.
issues.fix: Retain time and source severity with localized accessible/visible text using existing Badge/Text/help contracts.

requiredChecks: Real composed contrast in both themes and forced colors
Screen-reader names, form validation and evidence

states.initialLoading: JourneyPanel.tsx:281,320 list/detail skeletons; each subpanel uses contextual ListSkeleton inside SourceContent.
states.empty: List offers Plan journey; detail offers selection guidance; score/departure retain prerequisite shells; checklist special-cases latest 404 as never run.
states.fatalError: List/detail QueryError with retry; subpanels pass fatalError and retry to persistent SourceContent shells.
states.retained: Subpanels map stale to retained and keep payload; report additionally displays freshness/provenance through TripOperationalBrief.
states.offline: Queued check-ins supported by useQueuedCheckIn.ts:32-80; other source trust messages are generic retained text, not explicit offline details.
states.partialUnknown: Range/deviation/readiness/nudge have unknown labels; nullable SI measurements remain guarded. No invented zero metrics required.
states.mutations: Create/transition rely on hook toast feedback; score/replan/checklist have inline errors and pending indicators; check-in queues network/non-ApiError failures.

issues.detail: List/detail SourceContent only checks refreshError to select retained (detail line 310). Shared DataState can be stale when refresh is paused/offline without error, so these callers label that retained content ready and supply no retained retry.
issues.fix: Map full shared source status including blocked refresh, retaining list/detail and actionable recovery; do not collapse offline into empty/failure.

issues.detail: Departure and checklist shells disappear entirely without detail; all planning/live/debrief subpanels exist only within successful detail branch. Distinguish legitimate lifecycle-specific applicability from unknown/not-yet-loaded source so modernization does not silently erase capabilities.
issues.fix: Preserve lifecycle gates and provide explicit unavailable/loading selection context for persistent appropriate sections; never fetch/mutate a nonexistent session.

issues.detail: Create disables on null vehicle but empty state still invites planning; page consumes only vehicleId, so loading/no fleet/failed fleet are not distinguished here.
issues.fix: Use existing workspace/fleet state guidance without a second vehicle picker; expose the real reason creation is unavailable.

visualIssues.detail: Progress hardcodes emerald fallback #10b981; score bar similarly uses emerald #34d399 (StopScoreTable.tsx:54). These are saturation/theme-token review targets, not proof of neon/glow or failed contrast. Both explicitly set solid fill.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic progress/score tokens with restrained intensity after composed-theme review; retain measured progress/score and accessible labels.

visualIssues.detail: Recommended slot adds emerald border/background around a semantic Badge; mild duplicate emphasis worth reviewing against the page intensity budget.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic token treatment, retain the recommendation distinction and severity, avoid stronger glow/gradients.

architectureIssues.detail: UnitInput energy value/onChange is canonical Wh (UnitInput.tsx:53-59), but chargeNeed initializes to 40 at line 37 and submit multiplies it by 1000. This source wiring is inconsistent: an edited canonical Wh value would be multiplied again. Default intended charge need is not proven.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the controlled draft explicitly in Wh and send energy_wh unchanged; resolve intended default from authoritative behavior, not invented data. This is a caller integration correction, not permission to change UnitInput's SI API.

architectureIssues.detail: Subpanels are reused without session keys/reset. StopScorePanel retains selected candidates, arrival, chargeNeed and mutation result; ReplanPanel retains result. When opening another session of the same lifecycle, previous score/winner/version can remain associated visually with the new session.
architectureIssues.fix: Bind session-local drafts/results to session identity or reset on session change; preserve shared query keys and do not clear unrelated outbox entries.

architectureIssues.detail: Price header defaults to $/kWh while cells use formatCurrency preferences and unit_price has no explicit unit/currency metadata in the inspected TS interface. Backend price basis is unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve real unit_price and clarify authoritative source price basis before changing labels/conversions; do not infer Wh-normalization or USD from the display string.

priority.reason: Canonical energy input mismatch and cross-session retained mutation results are source-backed correctness risks. Mobile session actions and stale/offline mapping follow; cosmetic page rewrite is unnecessary.
order: Preserve all actions/mobile details and source states
Subdue only confirmed local presentation noise

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing state ready/loading/error/empty/retained, errorRecovery.onRetry, retainedMessage, loadingContent and emptyContent; DataState supplies isRefreshBlocked, status, refreshError and updatedAt. If unified paused/freshness presentation is needed, extend the existing owner only after inventory reconciliation.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing mobilePresentation with onOpenRow/inlineActions and all-column detail rendering; keep processed row order, table IDs, filtering/export ownership and source-backed columns. No replacement table.
requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Caller adoption/verification; shared implementation change not yet justified.

competingImplementations.detail: Named Journey Autopilot sessions and lifecycle are NOT equivalent to /trips recorded history or inferred observed journeys. Scoped search also found featureCatalog.ts:100 describes /journeys as stitched drives, inconsistent with the mounted page comment; only that search excerpt was inspected.
competingImplementations.decision: Preserve distinct source/domain meaning. Catalog description reconciliation belongs to the shared/integration owner, not this audit writer.

competingImplementations.detail: /journeys is not an analysis-range-enabled route; vehicle control is enabled by default at lines 155-166. Departure horizons and stop arrival input are independent business dates.
competingImplementations.decision: Do not add a page date/vehicle selector or force analysis-range semantics onto lifecycle sessions.

preservation.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of raw current page bytes
preservation.lineCountDefinition: Get-Content line counts of the page and twelve inspected presentation components; does not include hooks, outbox or shared library.

sections.name: Planned journeys list, status filter and create form
Journey detail, server lifecycle actions and plan-version history

actions: Filter all/planned/active/paused/completed/aborted; open selected session; automatic first available session selection.
Plan/cancel draft; required trimmed name up to 200 chars, optional trimmed origin/destination up to 300; create for workspace vehicle.
Server next_statuses controls start/pause/resume/complete/abort; retain pending and toast/error feedback.
Read plan versions, notes and timestamps.
Choose fleet sites with 10 candidate limit, set arrival instant and real canonical energy demand, score and show winner/version/all six score columns plus evidence.
Open charging history recovery link when no sites.
Choose independent 12/24/48h departure window; inspect recommendation, charge context and source hourly severities.
Run/re-check persisted readiness snapshot; retain checked timestamp, item details/statuses and 404-never-run recovery.
Inspect planned-session nudge, blockers and evidence.
Check in now/queue offline/replay ordered original instants; inspect live progress, have/need energy, next stop/wait, last fix and trail count.
Rescore from latest fix; inspect corridor verdict/deviation and resulting winner/version/ranking.
Inspect arrival ETA/moving state/pace/remaining distance, verdict/shortfall and route-history support.

Inspect seven report metrics: distance, duration, detour, fixes, replans of plans, usual factor over route-history trips, readiness count of checklist total; preserve summary details and freshness/provenance.
Source-local retry, retained content, shared table controls/value filters and existing export semantics must survive.
dataBehavior: Canonical meters, seconds and Wh stay raw in cache/hooks/wire; useUnits at display boundary. pace_ms is passed to formatSpeed but authoritative backend naming/units were not inspected.
Preserve percent SOC, dimensionless score/health/factors and independent denominators; absence is not zero.
Keep real evidence strings and source timestamps; never substitute fixture data.
Preserve status-appropriate sections rather than rendering live mutations for completed/nonexistent sessions.
Preserve query keys, enablement, AbortSignal, queryPolicy and invalidateAndBroadcast.
Outbox key teslasync.journey.checkin-outbox, session identity, original recorded_at and 50-entry cap are current source behavior; server replay/idempotency is unproven.
Journey session records, fleet charging sites, live checkpoints, checklist runs and route-history support are independent source identities.

evidenceLimits.mode: Phase 0 read-only source audit; only assigned JSON and heartbeat written
evidenceLimits.runtime: NOTRUN: no browser, mounted route, network calls, journey mutations or backend behavior tests
evidenceLimits.visualKeyboardContrastViewport: UNVERIFIED: no screenshots, theme/contrast measurements, keyboard/screen-reader or responsive execution
evidenceLimits.validation: No Git, agents, full-repository lint/build/tests or TypeScript run. audit.sh was read but not executed because it unconditionally runs project TypeScript, contrary to this bounded audit's validation restrictions.

sourceScans.command: PowerShell Select-String over explicit page/presentation dependency files; raw HTML repeated with -CaseSensitive to avoid capitalized shared-control false positives
sourceScans.qualification: Literal scans only, not proof shared primitives/shell render without white/neon/glow or contrast failures. Initial case-insensitive raw-element scan returned 14 shared Button/Input/Select false positives; corrected count is zero.

evidenceLimits.backend: Only router registration excerpts inspected; routes matched source hook paths. Handlers, DB/source correctness, units of unit_price/pace_ms, auth, filtering and live tick behavior not verified.
evidenceLimits.coverage: Page and direct trips presentation/data dependencies plus narrowly relevant shared contracts; no whole-app inventory/acceptance claim. Shared libraries read only cited ranges; scoped search excerpts are listed explicitly.
evidenceLimits.sourceDrift: Page hash pins inspected snapshot; other concurrent writers may change dependencies. Report does not lock their source.
